title: Junior Research Assistant (JRA)
organization: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology, Gorakhpur
summary: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology, Gorakhpur is inviting applications from Uttar Pradesh residents for one Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position under a CST, U.P. sponsored research project. The appointment is temporary for approximately two years with a monthly fellowship of Rs. 28,000. Selection will be based on a walk-in interview scheduled for December 15, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Essential Qualification: B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent with First Class degree.
Age Limit: Maximum 28 years as on 01/04/2026.
Domicile: Must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh state.
Desirable: Preference for candidates with expertise in IoT, Machine Learning, MATLAB, and Wireless Sensor Networks.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format from the official notification.
Fill out the application form completely and attach self-attested copies of supporting documents including mark sheets, certificates, and domicile proof.
Send the hard copy of the completed application to the Principal Investigator at the Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering, MMMUT Gorakhpur on or before 14/12/2026.
Send a scanned copy of the application along with proofs via email to dkkece@mmmut.ac.in by 14/12/2026.
Attend the walk-in interview on 15/12/2026 at 11:30 A.M. at the Electronics & Communication Engineering Department with original documents.
